description: One argument name resolved against the ChainHelix Agentic Lexicon: the entry (id, meaning, representation, unit, example) or, when the name is unknown or ambiguous, the candidates to choose from. Optional namespace (common, agent, identity, payment, wallet, onchain, defi, market, data) and venue (an exchange name, e.g. binance: a venue field name resolves through ccxt's mapping). Price: 5 cents per call. A ChainHelix API key does not cover this tool.

name.description: the argument name to resolve, e.g. origQty, stop_price, budgetUsd

venue.description: exchange name, lower case, e.g. binance

name: lexicon_resolve
